description: This file provides HTML sanitization functionality specifically tailored for Wikipedia content, ensuring safety by removing scripts, dangerous tags, and unsafe URL protocols, while preserving Wikipedia's formatting.

methods.name: isSafeUrlValue(value)
methods.description: Checks if a URL string is considered safe based on allowed protocols, relative URLs, and explicit blockers like javascript: and data: URIs.

methods.name: sanitizeWikipediaHtml(html)
methods.description: Sanitizes HTML input for safe rendering in Wikipedia-related contexts using DOMPurify with specific configurations to remove risky tags, attributes, and protocols, and to enforce link safety.
